#### `modin/core/dataframe/pandas/partitioning/partition_manager.py`
- **`to_pandas`**: Changed `pandas.concat([part for part in row], axis=axis)` to `pandas.concat([part for part in row], axis=axis, copy=False)`. This prevents redundant data copying when concatenating partitions into a single pandas object.

#### `modin/core/dataframe/pandas/utils.py`
- **`concatenate`**: Changed `pandas.concat(dfs)` to `pandas.concat(dfs, copy=False)`. This optimizes the concatenation of multiple DataFrames by avoiding an unnecessary copy if the data can be shared, which is relevant when `to_pandas` calls this utility.

These changes address the performance concerns raised in the issue by leveraging the `copy=False` parameter in pandas' `concat` method.
